name: Nebula Undertide
core_rationale: Innermost inverted-gravity whirlpool of Continent 03 where Vesper's tear suspended a spiraling sea of luminescent star-kelp and sunken astral galleons.
local_conflict: Abyssal star-serpents and slumber-echoes coil around the central gravity core, threatening to pull the outer sky-islands inward.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Inverted tidal pressure along the Abyssal Barometer Ridge crushes uncalibrated diving bells; the Undertide Bell-Keepers require the Cradle Star-Heart before unsealing the northern coral lock.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Divers who tether themselves over the Undertide rim claim the water above breathes in and out every twelve seconds like a sleeping child.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A slow-spinning vortex of violet nebula mist and upside-down coral spires floating at the center of the Shattered Halo.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Does Vesper the Dream-Eater still dream inside the heart of the Nebula Undertide?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly embodies the epicenter of scar-vesper-crater where Vesper's tear struck the northern ocean.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A floating vortex of violet nebula mist, luminescent star-kelp, and upside-down coral spires.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 13.0m coral-decked boardwalks, 0.60m diving-bell counters, and 0.14m shell-risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix ([0, 1] Kelp Spiral Reef, [1, 1] Undertide Sanctuary, [1, 1] floor -1 Vesper Cradle, [1, 0] Abyssal Barometer) with dragon, spirit, and aquatic families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-abyssal-barometer at [1, 0] as an intentional Mystery frontier gated by a fog_of_lore coral lock.
